verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a card-issuing and payments infrastructure platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk data export, open-format download, or offboarding/migration-out capability. The API endpoints for reading account activity are developer building blocks, not an export feature, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
